example.title: Townhouse condominiums on Nobel Drive
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A mid-1980s townhouse condominium court: two- and three-storey units of grey-brown stucco with gabled roofs, chimneys and small balconies, stepping down either side of a curving private drive with shrubs. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
